{{Quote|Welcome to the 7-Gee Lounge, sir. I'm your host, EV-7G7. Would you like a drink?|EV-7G7|<ref name="video game" />}}
'''EV-7G7''' was a modified [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] who served drinks to the patrons of the [[7-Gee Lounge]] at Mos Espa Arena in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
EV-7G7 functioned as a [[Waiter/Legends|barman]] in the 7-Gee Lounge. It was during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve podrace]] that he met a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. The droid offered him a drink, but instead, Qui-Gon asked about the whereabouts of [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. EV-7G7 could not help much in this issue, and suggested that the Jedi ask one of the patrons. Eventually Qui-Gon returned and ordered two glasses of [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]] for [[Watto's flunky]] and his friend [[Kreg]].

==Characteristics==
EV-7G7's pelvic mount was locked into a rail, which he used to move around the bar top.<ref name="video game" />

==Behind the scenes==
The player, in the guise of Jinn, must acquire juri juice from the droid to continue in the mission.

If the player orders too many drinks within a short period of time, EV-7G7 will cut Jinn off and refuse to serve him anymore.
